title: Private camper, 6 seats, sofa-cum-bed, spacious washroom, pantry, comfort seat tiers
spec: Private, 6 seats, sofa-cum-bed, spacious washroom with grey + black + cassette tanks, small pantry, small fridge, microwave, overhead + under-seat/floor storage, one infotainment unit, seat-back tablets, captain/recliner/massage-recliner seat options.
interpretation: 6 seats = 6 passenger seats excluding the driver (the OEM '+D' convention, the same one test B uses); one of them is the cab co-driver seat. The sofa-cum-bed is living furniture, not a designated travel seat. Each seat tier is checked separately. Base-vehicle age and the other conversion answers were not given, so they stay unanswered.
